scope.subtitle: What this role can and cannot do
scope.manager_restricted: Result approval is restricted to Pathologists and the Owner.
scope.manager_catalog_owner: Catalog and price edits are Owner-only; this dashboard never exposes an edit action.
scope.manager_partner_ledger: Partner registry and share-ledger writes stay with the Owner.
scope.technician_receive: Receive samples, enter results, and flag/reject bench specimens.
scope.technician_billing_hidden: Billing, payments, settlements and the partner ledger are hidden and refused by the API.
scope.technician_approval_owner: Clinical approval remains with the Pathologist or Owner.
scope.pathologist_approve: Approve or reject entered results, amend results, and record critical notifications.
scope.pathologist_reference: Review each result against its reference range before approving.
scope.pathologist_billing: Invoicing, payments and partner settlements are not part of this role.
